SIMULATED BUSINESS. This is a fictional policy for a synthetic company. It is not real.

1. Gift card purchases are non-refundable once the card code has been redeemed or any part of the balance has been used.
2. An unredeemed gift card may be refunded to the original payment method within 30 days of purchase.
3. Gift cards never expire and cannot be exchanged for cash except where the law requires it.
4. Store credit issued as a goodwill gesture is non-refundable and is valid for 24 months from the date it is issued.
5. A gift card balance may be applied to orders and to subscription charges, but not to the purchase of another gift card.
6. A lost or stolen gift card code can be replaced with proof of purchase; the replacement takes up to 5 business days.
7. Promotional credit is not redeemable for cash and expires 90 days after it is issued.
8. When a refund is approved for an order that was paid partly with a gift card, the gift card portion is returned as store credit rather than to the card.
9. Gift card orders are digital and are delivered by email within one hour of payment.
